title: Standards Browser
heading: Explore Indian Standards
subheading: Browse the standards currently available in the SAATHI prototype knowledge base.

descriptions.is4151: Covers the safety and performance requirements for protective helmets worn by riders and pillion passengers of two-wheelers.
descriptions.is302: Specifies general and specific safety requirements for household and similar electrical appliances sold in India.
descriptions.is1417: Defines the recognised grades of gold and gold alloys and their fineness for jewellery hallmarking.
descriptions.is14543: Sets out the requirements for packaged natural mineral water, including composition, hygiene and labelling.
descriptions.is2347: Specifies materials, construction, performance and safety requirements for aluminium household pressure cookers.
descriptions.is9873: Covers the mechanical and physical safety properties for toys intended for use by children.

detail.notYetAvailable: This section isn't in the prototype's knowledge base yet — check Overview, or ask SAATHI about {{standard}} directly.

disclaimer.heading: Illustrative checklist — not authoritative BIS guidance
disclaimer.body: This checklist is generated by the prototype from a small illustrative dataset, not a live BIS requirement list — verify the actual documents required for your application with BIS or an authorized certification body before relying on it.

documentChecklist.previewNote: This is a hypothetical preview only — it doesn't reflect or save any real choice, and has no effect on an actual application.
documentChecklist.previewApplies: Preview: applies for this applicant type.
documentChecklist.previewNotApplicable: Preview: doesn't apply for this applicant type.
documentChecklist.previewUnresolved: Select an applicant type above to preview whether this applies.

sources.officialPortal: Bureau of Indian Standards — Official Portal
sources.note: The prototype links to BIS's official portal rather than a specific document — verify the current, exact text of {{standard}} there.

qco.checking: Checking against the Quality Control Order database…
qco.idleBody: See whether a Quality Control Order (QCO) currently makes BIS certification mandatory for {{standard}}.
qco.demoNotice: This is a demo check against a small illustrative dataset, not a live BIS query — verify directly with BIS before relying on this result.

error.heading: Couldn't complete the check
error.body: Something went wrong while checking QCO applicability. Try again, or ask SAATHI in chat.

applicable.why: {{standard}} is covered by a notified Quality Control Order, so BIS certification is mandatory for {{product}}.

unableToDetermine.heading: Not enough data to determine applicability
unableToDetermine.body: The prototype's knowledge base doesn't yet have QCO mapping data for {{standard}}. This is not a determination that no QCO applies — verify directly with BIS.

revision.demoNotice: This is a demo comparison against a small illustrative dataset, not a live BIS query — verify directly with BIS before relying on this result.

noHistory.heading: No revision history yet
noHistory.body: The prototype doesn't have any revision history mapped for {{standard}} yet.

error.heading: Couldn't complete the comparison
error.body: Something went wrong while comparing revisions. Try again, or ask SAATHI in chat.

singleRevision.heading: Only one verified revision exists
singleRevision.body: The prototype only has a verified edition from {{revision}} for this standard — there's nothing to compare it against yet.

unverifiedResult.heading: One of these editions isn't verified yet
unverifiedResult.body: The source text for at least one of the selected editions hasn't been confirmed yet — only its metadata is on record. A comparison isn't available until it's verified.

extractionInsufficient.heading: Can't reliably compare these editions
extractionInsufficient.body: At least one selected edition's only available source is a scanned or image-only document, so text extraction isn't reliable enough to compare clause-by-clause yet.

compared.partialNotice: Partial comparison — this shows a hand-picked subset of changes between these editions, not an exhaustive clause-by-clause diff.
compared.noHighImpact: No high-impact changes in this comparison.

complianceGaps.idleBody: Upload the documents you have for {{standard}} and see which requirements are met, which need attention, and which still need evidence.
complianceGaps.demoNotice: This is an illustrative check against a small mock dataset, not a real compliance audit — no documents are uploaded or stored anywhere, and this doesn't replace verification with BIS or an accredited lab.

error.heading: Couldn't complete the analysis
error.body: Something went wrong while analyzing compliance gaps. Try again, or ask SAATHI in chat.

noRequirementsData.heading: No gap-analysis data for this standard yet
noRequirementsData.body: The prototype doesn't have compliance requirements mapped for {{standard}} yet — this is not a determination that the product is compliant or non-compliant.

summary.criticalBanner: Critical Gap: a mandatory requirement failed or is missing required evidence — a high readiness percentage doesn't mean this product is compliant.

recommendedActions.heading: Recommended Actions
recommendedActions.empty: No outstanding actions — every requirement passed.

readiness.idleBody: See whether an application for {{standard}} is ready to submit, based on the documents you have so far.
readiness.demoNotice: This is an illustrative check against a small mock dataset, not a real readiness determination — no documents are uploaded or stored anywhere, and this doesn't replace verification with BIS or an accredited lab.

error.heading: Couldn't complete the check
error.body: Something went wrong while checking application readiness. Try again, or ask SAATHI in chat.

insufficientEvidence.heading: Not enough information to determine readiness yet
insufficientEvidence.body: The prototype doesn't have enough compliance data for {{standard}} to determine application readiness. This is not a determination that the application is or isn't ready — check Compliance Gaps directly, or ask SAATHI in chat.

statusDescription.ready: Every requirement, mandatory and non-mandatory, is satisfied.
statusDescription.ready_with_non_blocking: All mandatory requirements are satisfied. Some non-mandatory items are still outstanding — they don't block submission, but resolving them strengthens the application.
statusDescription.not_ready: A mandatory requirement is failing or missing required evidence. This application cannot proceed until it's resolved — regardless of the score below.

blockingIssues.heading: Blocking Issues
blockingIssues.empty: No blocking issues — every mandatory requirement is satisfied.
